campaign.name: Poland · Creator pilot
campaign.brief: Reach travellers with a relevant flight disruption. Help them complete a flight check and submit an eligible passenger claim.

creators.name: Amelia & Albin
creators.notes: STATS: 1.8M post views 28d (-2.1%), 58.4K likes, 1K comments (+58.9%), 14.6K shares, 9.6K profile views. 822.1k total viewers (+10.9%), 233.1k new (+181.5%). 30d: 624,137 views, +939 followers, 46% from followers. Reels 445k / Stories 177k. Age 25-34 34.8%, 35-44 23.4%, 45-54 18.4%, 55+ 6.2% = 82.8% over 25 - oldest of any respondent. Followers 76% F. Top content: Albania and cheap city breaks from Poland. 9h delay returning from Egypt - ready-made story. Students under 26 so umowa zlecenie is tax-free. Declined free flight check. Strong affiliate track record, emphasise natural integration over polish. Stats attached in reply.
creators.source: Winglex Creator Tracker - Poland.csv · supplied September 2026
creators.rationale: First pilot candidate: personal nine-hour Egypt flight-delay story and relevant travel content. Eligibility of the story is unverified.
creators.gaps: Polish audience share missing. Confirm the PLN 3,000 bundle scope and comparable sponsored reach. Reconcile platform and reporting windows.

creators.name: Zuzia & Maks

IG audience 91% Poland, 76.2% F, age 35-44 31.6% / 25-34 29.2% / 45-54 22.5% = 91.3% over 25. TikTok 99.3% Poland, 62% F, 25-34 29.6% / 18-24 26.8% = 73.2% over 25. Stories 4.1-28.3k views per frame. ERGO travel insurance is a running deal (code TRAVELOVCY15) - closest category conflict. Volvo ambassadorship started 25 Aug, may limit Sept slots. Sponsored posts appear boosted: MG Motor 1.16M views at 0.10% ER. Ask for organic-only reach.

creators.rationale: Relevant reported audience, but the current quote needs stronger evidence of acquisition performance.
creators.gaps: Request organic sponsored-post results. Check ERGO category restrictions. Paid amplification is suspected in the source notes, not verified.
